elements.description: Export a list: format, which rows and which columns, then progress, a download link, or an email when it's ready.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the dialog is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading

properties.name: description
properties.description: A line under the heading: what's being exported

properties.name: formats
properties.description: The formats on offer, in order

properties.name: format
properties.description: The format picked. Changed by the user unless a tc-format-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: counts
properties.description: How many rows each choice holds: the selected ones, the ones the filters show (unset: no filters) and all

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Which rows to export. Changed by the user unless a tc-rows-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: columns
properties.description: The columns on offer, in order; required ones can't be left out

properties.name: selectedColumns
properties.description: The ids of the columns to export; unset, all of them. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-columns-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: email
properties.description: The person's email address; set, "Email me when it's ready" is offered

properties.name: emailMe
properties.description: Whether to email the file instead of waiting; unset, ticked when the rows exceed `email-threshold`. Changed by the user unless a tc-email-me-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: emailThreshold
properties.description: Above this many rows "Email me" starts ticked (default 5000)

properties.name: status
properties.description: Where the export is: "idle" (the form), "preparing", "ready", "emailed" or "failed" – the page's to set after tc-export

properties.name: progress
properties.description: How far preparing has got, 0–1; unset, the bar moves without a number

properties.name: downloadUrl
properties.description: The file to download, when ready

properties.name: fileName
properties.description: The file's name, when ready

properties.name: fileSize
properties.description: The file's size in bytes, when ready

properties.name: error
properties.description: What went wrong, when it failed

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The locale for numbers

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Rename any of the words

properties.name: exportColumns
properties.description: The columns that will be exported: the picked ones plus every required one, in the columns' order

properties.name: emailing
properties.description: Whether "Email me" is ticked: as set, or by default when the rows exceed the threshold

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The dialog was opened or closed ({ open }: ExportDialogOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays as it was

events.name: tc-format-change
events.description: A format was picked ({ format }: ExportFormatChange); cancelable – prevented, `format` stays as it was

events.name: tc-rows-change
events.description: Which rows was picked ({ rows }: ExportRowsChange); cancelable – prevented, `rows` stays as it was

events.name: tc-selected-columns-change
events.description: The columns changed ({ selectedColumns }: ExportSelectedColumnsChange); cancelable – prevented, `selectedColumns` stays as it was

events.name: tc-email-me-change
events.description: "Email me" was ticked or unticked ({ emailMe }: ExportEmailMeChange); cancelable – prevented, `emailMe` stays as it was

events.name: tc-export
events.description: Export or Retry was pressed ({ format, rows, columns, emailMe }: ExportRequest); the page starts the export and sets `status`

events.name: tc-export-cancel
events.description: Cancel was pressed while preparing (detail: null); the page stops the export

functions.name: exportFileSize
functions.description: "12 KB", "3.4 MB" – a file's size for people

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on mount when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The dialog was opened or closed

props.name: defaultFormat
props.description: The format on mount when `format` isn't controlled (default "csv")

props.name: defaultRows
props.description: Which rows on mount when `rows` isn't controlled (default "all")

props.name: selectedColumns
props.description: The ids of the columns to export – controlled when given

props.name: defaultSelectedColumns
props.description: The columns on mount when `selectedColumns` isn't controlled (default all)

props.name: emailMe
props.description: Whether to email the file – controlled when given

props.name: onExport
props.description: Export or Retry was pressed: start the export and set `status`

props.name: onExportCancel
props.description: Cancel was pressed while preparing: stop the export

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
